context: A stack re-plan where the agent is the intent that waits

checklist.name: reads_role
checklist.description: Recognises that it is `then`, so its intent should build on i2222222222 rather than race it.

checklist.name: suggestion_only
checklist.description: States that the re-plan is a suggestion and nothing was re-planned automatically.

checklist.name: restack_command
checklist.description: Re-plans with `wayglass intent restack i1111111111 --on i2222222222 --reason "..." --json` (the `replan.command`, with a real reason that says why it builds on i2222222222) rather than declaring a new intent with `--on` and abandoning the old one, or an invented command such as `intent stack` or `intent update`.

checklist.name: propose_again
checklist.description: Says that the intent keeps its id, that any earlier decision no longer counts so it proposes again after the restack, that it lands after i2222222222, and that a `restack_conflict` means nothing changed and the user hears about it.

checklist.name: no_premature_propose
checklist.description: Does not propose the overlapping change on the old intent before re-planning, and checks with the user before discarding work.
